description: More like this: the public consulting calls open now most like one result of search_tenders (an open call or an award), ranked as the radar's 'More like this' (precomputed neighbours and the stored bge-m3 vectors of every notice; no model is called). The awards of the last six months close to it come only as an aggregate (past: how many, values, bids, frequent winners; no figures under a few awards), never row by row. Give the result's notice link as id. Optional filters: status, country, kind, min_value_eur; when nothing similar is inside them, filters are let go of one at a time and the answer says which (min_value_eur is kept). Rows come as in search_tenders (links, title_en, page), paged; counts as one call against the daily caps.

country.description: A country (ISO code or name), or several separated by commas.

id.description: The notice link of a search_tenders result (its notice field), or a TED notice number such as 796576-2026.

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

via.description: Leave this out. Set only by the radar's panel (MCP App) when the person uses its filters or 'show more' (panel), or by the site owner's own tests (dev), so that use is counted apart.

name: similar_tenders
title: Find open calls like one
